title: Adaptive latency safeguard and synthetic cohort curation for perf CI
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Build a CI-friendly benchmarking harness that (1) curates short, medium, and long synthetic cohorts representative of production prefix/caching behavior, (2) runs an adaptive latency safeguard that exercises kernel routing and attention optimizations under prefill->decode transitions, and (3) produces deterministic reference baselines (reference lockfile) and CI perf gate artifacts that make regressions actionable for engineers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Synthetic cohort generator produces three stable cohorts (seeded) with documented distributions (seq_len, prefix_entropy, cache_hit_pct) and stored lockfile. 2) CI job runs cohorts and calculates per-model P50/P95/P99, decode tail (p99.9) and cost-per-token delta relative to reference. 3) Perf gate fails when P95 regression >5% or decode p99.9 increase >10ms or cost-per-token >3%. 4) Dashboard shows per-route diff and links to kernel-selection traces and KV cache-hit heatmap.
implementation_notes: Plan: (A) Implement synthetic cohort generator as a small Go/TS binary that samples from an empirical distribution derived from production traces (anonymized). Components: seq_len sampler, prefix-entropy estimator, cache-hit simulator, and header to mark cohort. (B) Add an adaptive runner that can vary prefill:decode ratios and intentionally toggle kernel-routing flags (routing variants) in a controlled matrix. (C) Persist runs to an 'reference lockfile' in S3 for each model+revision; CI compares current run to the lockfile. (D) Add perf-gate step to CI which uploads metrics to the perf-dashboard and fails the pipeline if thresholds exceeded. (E) Provide a lightweight prober job to run the cohort on a small reserve of dedicated capacity nightly and emit alerts for drift.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: synthetic cohorts may not reflect client edge-cases (e.g., extreme KV cache reuse). Mitigation: include a stage to replay sampled production traces monthly and fold new patterns into the empirical sampler. Risk: CI flakiness due to noisy infra. Mitigation: require two consecutive failing CI runs (or run on dedicated commit-only capacity) before an automatic rollback or blocking action.
metrics_and_gates: Primary: model-level P50, P95, P99, decode p99.9 tail; Secondary: tokens/sec, cost-per-token, kernel-switch frequency, avg KV cache-hit rate. Gates: fail if P95_current > P95_ref * 1.05 OR decode_p99.9_current > decode_p99.9_ref + 10ms OR cost_per_token_current > cost_per_token_ref * 1.03. On failure: auto-open ENG ticket with diff summary and link to traces.
plan_milestones: 2025-03-03: CI perf-gate integration and dashboard plumbing
